shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && echo "---PKG---" && cat /workspace/package.json && echo "---DOCS---" && ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "viewtransition\|view-transition\|view transition" . | head -50
wc -l 01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md 01-app/02-guides/interactive-apps.md 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md && echo "=====VT=====" && cat 01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md
cd /workspace && find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -60 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx" lib/products.ts; do echo "=========== $f ==========="; cat "$f"; done
cat app/globals.css && echo "=====EVAL=====" && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && echo "=====LINK transitionTypes=====" && grep -n -A 40 "transitiontypes\|transitionTypes" 01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -80
grep -n -i -B3 -A12 "viewTransition" 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md | head -60

cd /workspace && echo "--- react version installed ---" && node -p "require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version" && echo "--- ViewTransition in react types? ---" && grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20 && echo "--- ViewTransition in react runtime? ---" && node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('ViewTransition' in r, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.unstable_ViewTransition)"
git diff package.json && echo "=== vendored react dirs ===" && ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/ | grep -i "^react"

node -p "require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/package.json').version" && echo "--- ViewTransition in vendored react ---" && grep -o "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | head -3 && node -e "const r=require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react'); console.log('VT:', typeof r.ViewTransition)"

node -p "require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version" && echo "--- next.d.ts / types shims mentioning ViewTransition ---" && grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/*.d.ts node_modules/next/types/ node_modules/next/dist/lib/ 2>/dev/null | head && echo "--- tsconfig ---" && cat tsconfig.json && ls next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "(no next-env.d.ts)"
grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/ | head && echo "=== decl ===" && grep -rn -B5 -A30 "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60
grep -rn 'reference types=' node_modules/next/dist/lib/*.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/**/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map" | head -20

grep -rn 'canary\|experimental' node_modules/next/types/global.d.ts node_modules/next/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "--- files ---"; ls node_modules/next/*.d.ts node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rn -i "viewTransition" 01-app/02-guides/interactive-apps.md | head -20 && echo "=== any config flag? ===" && grep -rn -i "viewTransition\s*:" . | head
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; echo "tsc exit: $?"
timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -35

(timeout 90 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; echo "=== HOME ===" ; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'view-transition[^;"]*' | sort -u; echo "=== HOME thumbnail markup ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '<div class="product-image"[^>]*>' | head -2; echo "=== DETAIL ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<div class="product-hero"[^>]*>' | head -2

echo "=== HOME main + grid ===" && curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '<main[^>]*>\|<div class="product-grid"[^>]*>' && echo "=== DETAIL root + info ===" && curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c && echo "=== CSS shipped? ===" && curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.css' | head -1
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom && ls cjs | head -20 && grep -rlno "vt-enter" cjs/*.js | head
grep -n -B25 '"vt-enter"' cjs/react-dom-server.node.development.js | head -60
grep -n -A22 "function getClassNameByType" cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -30

cd /workspace && grep -rn "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/links.js node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "--- server log ---"; tail -3 /tmp/next.log
grep -rln "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/client/ | head -8
grep -n -B4 -A6 "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-instance.js | head -40

curl -s localhost:3111/_next/static/chunks/3hib40h2gssse.css > /tmp/out.css && wc -c /tmp/out.css && echo "=== VT rules present? ===" && grep -o '::view-transition[a-z-]*([^)]*)' /tmp/out.css | sort -u && echo "=== reduced motion ===" && grep -o 'prefers-reduced-motion[^{]*{[^}]*}[^}]*}[^}]*}' /tmp/out.css | head -c 600

grep -o '::view-transition{[^}]*}' /tmp/out.css; grep -c 'skeleton-image,.skeleton-text{animation:none}\|animation:none' /tmp/out.css; grep -o '\.skeleton-image[^}]*animation:none[^}]*}' /tmp/out.css | head -3; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; echo done
ls -a | grep -i "vitest\|test" ; find . -name "*.test.*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | head; echo "--- git status ---"; git status --short
git diff tsconfig.json; echo "--- .gitignore? ---"; ls -a | grep gitignore || echo "NONE"
cat .gitignore
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPECHECK OK" && git status --short
rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git diff --stat && echo "--- final tree state ---" && git status --short
